items.title: EIA expects a drop in global oil demand will limit price increases from Hormuz disruptions
items.desc: The U.S. Energy Information Administration published its June Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO), reducing its expectation for global oil demand in 2026. High fuel prices, reduced fuel availability, and government initiatives are curbing oil consumption this year, particularly in Asia, resulting in the world consuming 1 million fewer barrels of oil each day on average than it did last year. The reduced demand could limit crude oil price increases resulting from near-term disruptions in the flow of oil out of the Middle East through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
items.desc: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallon of crude oil from the wholesale price of a gallon of refined product. Since May, the gasoline crack spread in New York Harbor has averaged about $1 per gallon (gal) higher than in 2025, when the crack spread peaked around 60 cents/gal. Gasoline crack spreads are elevated primarily because of tight gasoline supplies globally.

items.data_note: 原油价格高企，全球馏分油供应紧张
items.impact: 支撑柴油裂解价差，利好炼油利润

items.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
items.desc: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry Hub.
items.title_zh: 新英格兰天然气价格对Henry Hub折价接近纪录水平
items.desc_zh: 低成本阿巴拉契亚和加拿大天然气供应叠加区域消费低于往常，推动新英格兰主要定价枢纽气价对Henry Hub大幅折价。
items.event: 新英格兰气价对Henry Hub大幅折价
items.data_note: 低成本供应叠加消费低于往常，折价近纪录
items.impact: 区域气价承压，Henry Hub相对偏强

items.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
items.desc: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S. LNG exports will average 17.3 Bcf/d in the second half of 2026 (2H26) before rising to 18.7 Bcf/d in 1H27.
items.title_zh: 美国2026年上半年LNG出口增长23%
items.desc_zh: 产能提升推动美国LNG出口上半年均值达174亿立方英尺/日，同比增长23%；EIA预计全年均值173亿立方英尺/日。
items.event: 美国上半年LNG出口同比增23%
items.data_note: 出口均值174亿立方英尺/日，全年预计173亿
items.impact: 增加全球LNG供应，气价承压

items.title: World Bank lifts copper price outlook by 18%
items.desc: The bank’s upward revisions extend beyond copper.
items.title_zh: 世界银行上调铜价预测18%
items.desc_zh: 世界银行大幅上调铜价展望，且上调范围不仅限于铜。
items.event: 世界银行上调铜价展望18%
items.data_note: 铜价展望上调18%，范围不限于铜
items.impact: 利好铜价预期，但LME铜跌0.07%存背离

items.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
items.desc: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
items.title_zh: 美国炼油厂2026年开工率维持高位
items.desc_zh: 美国炼厂今年开工率高于正常水平，5月至9月产能利用率平均超95%，为1998年以来同期最高。全球成品油供应紧张提振石油产品利润率，尤其是燃料油。
items.event: 美国炼厂开工率创1998年来同期最高
items.data_note: 5-9月产能利用率均超95%，燃料油利润率获提振
items.impact: 利好原油及燃料油，支撑炼厂利润

items.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
items.desc: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
items.title_zh: Corpus Christi LNG扩建使该设施成为美国第二大LNG基地
items.desc_zh: 2026年8月28日，Cheniere Energy完成德克萨斯州Corpus Christi液化三期项目，接管该项目第七列也是最后一列LNG液化装置。
items.event: Cheniere完成Corpus Christi三期扩产
items.data_note: 8月28日接管第七列装置，成美国第二大LNG设施
items.impact: 增加LNG供应预期，天然气价格承压

items.title: Gold dip draws Asian buyers as North American funds lose cash
items.desc: Lower gold prices boost Indian premiums to $15/oz and increase Chinese trading as North American investors pull out.
items.title_zh: 金价下跌吸引亚洲买家，北美基金撤离
items.desc_zh: 金价走低推动印度溢价升至15美元/盎司，中国交易量增加，而北美投资者正在撤出。
items.event: 金价走低亚洲买盘承接北美资金撤离
items.data_note: 印度溢价升至15美元/盎司，中国交易量增加
items.impact: COMEX黄金跌0.33%，亚洲实物需求托底

items.title: Copper, nickel at risk due to El Niño’s disruptions
items.desc: El Niño could disrupt copper and nickel production through early 2027, BMI reports.
items.title_zh: 厄尔尼诺扰动或危及铜、镍供应
items.desc_zh: BMI报告称，厄尔尼诺可能扰乱铜和镍生产直至2027年初。
items.event: 厄尔尼诺或扰乱铜镍生产至2027年初
items.data_note: BMI报告预警，LME铜跌0.07%、铝跌0.29%
items.impact: 铜镍供应扰动预期，价格存上行风险

items.title: HyProMag USA PFS outlines $2.1B upside from rare earth magnet platform expansion
items.desc: Company eyes expanding beyond its first plant in Northlake, Texas, which is in detailed engineering.
items.title_zh: HyProMag USA PFS显示稀土磁体平台扩建带来21亿美元上行空间
items.desc_zh: 公司计划在德克萨斯州Northlake首家工厂之外扩张，该工厂正处于详细工程设计阶段。
items.event: HyProMag拟扩产稀土磁材平台
items.data_note: PFS显示扩张带来21亿美元上行空间
items.impact: 稀土磁材供应预期增加，北方稀土跌0.62%

items.title: Mule Canyon gold resource advances restart plans
items.desc: The next steps include upgrading inferred material, establishing the economics and securing restart permits.
items.title_zh: Mule Canyon金矿资源推进重启计划
items.desc_zh: 下一步包括升级推断资源量、确立经济性并取得重启许可。
items.event: 金矿项目推进重启审批
items.impact: 黄金供给预期微增，金价短期承压

items.title: Oil exploration opens door to Brazil offshore potash
items.desc: South Atlantic Potash plans to tap deposits beneath the Sergipe coast, a region historically used for oil extraction.
items.title_zh: 石油勘探为巴西海上钾盐开发打开大门
items.desc_zh: South Atlantic Potash计划开发Sergipe海岸下钾盐矿床，该地区历史上用于石油开采。
items.event: 石油区发现钾盐矿床开发计划
items.impact: 钾肥供给预期增加，对钾肥品种偏空

items.title: Anfield Energy secures draft State approvals for Utah uranium mill
items.desc: The Shootaring Canyon Mill in Garfield County is one of only three licensed, permitted, and constructed conventional uranium mills in the US.
items.title_zh: Anfield Energy获得犹他州铀矿厂初步州级批准
items.desc_zh: Garfield县Shootaring Canyon Mill是美国仅有的三座持证、获批并建成的常规铀矿厂之一。
items.event: 美铀矿厂获州级初步批准
items.data_note: 暂无铀品种数据
items.impact: 铀矿供给预期增加，对铀价偏空

items.title: Labour shortage hurts West Lake Gold output
items.desc: The company cut its annual production target by 25% due to labor shortages and slowdowns at its Madsen gold mine.
items.title_zh: 劳动力短缺影响West Lake Gold产量
items.desc_zh: 因劳动力短缺及Madsen金矿进度放缓，公司将年度产量目标下调25%。
items.event: 西湖金矿因缺工下调产量25%
items.impact: 黄金供给减少，对金价偏多

items.title: China Gold restarts CSH mine after five-month shutdown
items.desc: Open-pit operations resumed in early October following the completion of remediation work on the site.
items.title_zh: China Gold重启停产五个月的CSH矿
items.desc_zh: 现场修复工作完成后，露天开采于10月初恢复。
items.event: 中国黄金CSH矿停产五月后复产
items.impact: 黄金供给恢复，对金价偏空
